title: Every stage that ran the idle-worker watcher or read the CHIM label module was marked not reusable: rc1-try2 had 24 unexpected rebuilds
status: Fixed in v0.0.48 (24 October 2026): the v0.0.48-rc1 build marked its stages not reusable at their end ("ran 1 repository functions its fingerprint left out (first: tools/build_parallel.py:_watch_stage_pool)"; five also "read 1 repository files its fingerprint left out (first: tools/chim_compat.py)"), so the rc1-try2 reuse preflight planned 24 UNEXPECTED rebuilds and was stopped after 6 minutes. Both are output-neutral by design: _watch_stage_pool is a scheduling unit (SCHEDULING_UNITS, BUILD-POOL-MEMORY-PEAK-48) started by the pool_status instrumentation hook, which the reach does not follow; tools/chim_compat.py is loaded only by the cache key code (BUILD-CHIM-LABEL-IN-KEYS-48). check_calls now skips scheduling units and chim_compat.py is an instrumentation module. The rc1 records stay refused (the verdict is stored at stage end), so rc1-try3 rebuilds those stages once; the final reuses them.

platform_reason: build-time reuse check

title: After a streamed crossing into another region frame, that frame s doors cannot be used: the engine reads only the start frame s door bank (830 of 1,102 entrances)
status: Open: found by the door audit (tools/door_audit.py, 2026-10-25 17:54 +0200 / 2026-10-25 15:54 UTC) from the five dead entrances the maintainer reported (CHIM-REGION-DOORS-NO-PROMPT-42). With chim crossing 1 (the type 1 window, default since v0.0.47) a walk into another region frame streams it and sv.name stays the start frame; aw_scene.c read_links reads doors-<sv.name>.txt and aimed_door, door_status, AW_SceneActivate and the door_ready check compare against sv.name, while the frame the player stands in is the logical scene (logical_map, logical_offset, already used for crossings). Every one of the five doors is placed, linked and correct in its own frame; each was 14 to 35 map units from the player, inside the 56-unit reach, with no row read. Of the 1,102 exterior entrances, all usable on arrival by a level change, only 272 (the Balmora, Seyda Neen and Vivec town frames) are usable after walking in; Grazelands 0 of 67, Azure s Coast 0 of 171, Red Mountain 0 of 12. Fix: read the door bank of the logical frame (or of every frame the window holds), with the player s eye moved by the logical offset; check the hinged doors (aw_hinged_door.c) the same way. 2026-10-26 14:50 +0200 / 2026-10-26 12:50 UTC: fixed in source, b7af3db8, test tests/aga_scene_test.c (test_scene_links_preserve_state_and_find_hatch_floor: a streamed crossing seyda -> vf0000 picks vf0000's door from its own table with the eye shifted into its coordinates, the wall trace back in the running map, the timed door opening in the same frame; fails on the v0.0.52 aw_scene.c); in-game door audit across a crossing to do. Not covered yet: AW_SceneActivate and the hinged doors (aw_hinged_door.c). 2026-10-26 17:50 +0200 / 2026-10-26 15:50 UTC: the two paths left are covered. A script's Activate on a load door (AW_SceneActivate) now reads the door table of the frame the player stands in and takes only that frame's rows after a streamed crossing; before, it looped over the table read last (the start frame's when no pick had run since the crossing: the start frame's doors opened from the new frame, the new frame's were no doors). Test: tests/aga_scene_test.c (test_scene_links_preserve_state_and_find_hatch_floor: after seyda -> vf0000 by a streamed crossing, Activate on seyda's Registration entrance does nothing and on vf0000's mine entrance opens it; fails on 7cb82391's aw_scene.c). The hinged doors (aw_hinged_door.c) needed no change: CHIM places a streamed frame's placements at its window slot's offset, in the running map's coordinates like the player, so they are picked and turned with no shift; the game data has 11 exterior hinged doors in 6 cells, far under the 256-door table. A guard case in tests/aga_hinged_door_test.c (chim: a placement 2048 east and 1024 north of the start frame's origin, picked and opened from there) passes before and after. In-game audit across a crossing in v0.0.53-dev1/dev2 to do. 2026-10-26 21:58 +0200 / 2026-10-26 19:58 UTC: checked across a crossing on the v0.0.53-dev2 image. Natively, tools/door_engine_check.py (the engine's own aw_scene.c over the image's door banks, maps and directory, every region-frame door reached by a walk over a frame border from a neighbouring frame): 1,102 of 1,102 exterior entrances give the prompt, load their room by the use key and by Activate, and lead back out; the same image through the v0.0.52 aw_scene.c: 272. In game (FS-UAE, the dev2 engine and image, a teleport into a neighbouring frame and a noclip walk over the border, then walking at the door): the maintainer's five and four more entered (Yassu Mine, Nerano Ancestral Tomb, Tel Vos Dungeon, Indoranyon, Hanud, Pelagiad North Wall, Gnisis Abelmawia Hut, Ald-ruhn Council Club). Fixed in v0.0.53-dev1 (picking) and dev2 (Activate). Shipped in v0.0.53 (2026-10-26 23:48 +0200 / 2026-10-26 21:48 UTC): the door engine check, now part of every build, gives 1,102 of 1,102 after a walk over a frame border.
